Estimated route times

Coverage and limits: the colored outlines are 5/10/15-minute OSM/Valhalla road-time areas generated without live congestion. Colored markers show modeled route ETAs for five sampled approach origins; they are not traffic speed measurements for every road inside the isochrones. Compare each origin with itself across dates/hours; absolute ETAs differ by route distance. The assumed curve has weekday and weekend shapes, with no date-specific incidents, weather, holidays, or daily variation. Only the outlined snapshot markers are point-in-time Google Maps UI readings from 14 Oct 2026, 14:51–14:54 IST. Basemap © OpenStreetMap contributors.
